bnetza_hesse_slice.csv.extraction: Rows with Bundesland='Hessen' and Kreis in {Kreisfreie Stadt Frankfurt am Main, Kreisfreie Stadt Wiesbaden, Landkreis Groß-Gerau, Landkreis Main-Kinzig-Kreis}; Excel serial dates converted to ISO; comma decimals normalized. The airport operator label was replaced with the display name Frankfurt Airport. This real slice is the t2 station attributes; t0/t1 states are seeded synthetic history (generator.py).

smard_prices_slice.csv.source: Bundesnetzagentur SMARD market data (via Fraunhofer ISE energy-charts API)
smard_prices_slice.csv.extraction: DE-LU day-ahead prices, 15-minute resolution, UTC window 2025-10-01T00:00Z..2026-05-11T00:00Z; null-price slots dropped (recorded in extraction note); grid_load_mwh carried as an empty column (endpoint does not provide load series; contract allows NULL).

ecb_fx_slice.csv.source: ECB Data Portal reference exchange rates
ecb_fx_slice.csv.license: ECB Data Portal terms of use (ECB reference rates, public)
ecb_fx_slice.csv.extraction: Daily reference rates in ECB base notation: rate = foreign currency units per 1 EUR; business days only (weekends/TARGET2 holidays absent).
